# Dedicated feature-audit agent: djshellshoxxx/group-whisper-link

Check AGENTS.md and handoffs before starting. Inventory full feature scope using README, architecture, spec, roadmap, source, tests, CI, open PRs/issues and divergent branches. Trace advertised and undocumented features from interface entrypoint to processing, persistence, output and errors. Inspect unused code, unconnected controls, TODO/FIXME, stub and placeholder paths, missing dependencies/assets, format/platform compatibility and unfinished integrations. Confirm each feature with path and line citations and test evidence; classify verified complete / implemented untested / partial / stub / missing / planned-only / not applicable. Never describe unmerged PRs as released.

Run focused tests when possible and record exact commands/results. Identify essential missing features and high-value enhancements with P0-P3 priorities, technical dependencies and acceptance tests. Publish comprehensive docs/feature-audit/FEATURE_AUDIT_2026-10-12.md from a separate isolated branch and PR, including base commit SHA, feature matrix, issue/PR status, evidence, remaining gaps, and explicit limitations. Do not change app code, active branches, releases or credentials; coordinate with other active contributors.
